name: Viana do Castelo – Cabedelo
notes: Windiest spot in Portugal (nortada): waves outside, flatter by the river-mouth pier. Also: Caminha – Moledo (waves).

name: Esposende – Ofir
notes: Flat knee-deep lagoon in the Cávado estuary behind the Ofir sandspit (walk or school boat), waves on the sea side.

name: Murtosa – Ria de Aveiro
notes: Flat shallow lagoon, nortada thermal Apr–Oct; school (Clube Nortada). Also: Aveiro – Praia da Barra (waves on the ocean side).

name: Lagoa de Óbidos
notes: Flat, waist-deep lagoon; lighter wind (big kites). Lagoon mouth area closed to kites 15 Jun–15 Sep. Also: Peniche – Baleal (ocean, N and S winds on different sides).

name: Guincho
notes: Very strong nortada, waves: advanced riders.

name: Fonte da Telha
notes: Closest spot to Lisbon; all levels, lighter wind.

name: Lagoa de Albufeira
notes: Flat-water lagoon behind the sandbar; tricky at low tide.

name: Alvor
notes: Ria de Alvor: flat, shallow lagoon with sandbars; gusty.

name: Praia de Faro
notes: Ilha de Faro: waves on the ocean, flat water in the Ria Formosa (tide matters); schools. Also: Fuseta (Ria Formosa lagoon, tide matters).

name: Porto Santo
notes: 9 km beach; N wind is side-offshore and gusty in summer: experienced riders.
